# Tax Documentation: Retrieve Tax Documentation Data

Area overview and notes: [tax-documentation.md](../tax-documentation.md)

`GET /tax-documentation-data` · account-owner-scoped token

Returns the Tax Documentation Data for an Account Owner

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `unmask` | string | No | Whether to unmask sensitive information in the response. One of: `true`, `false`. |
